import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime
base=Path('data-dumps');suffix='window_pilot_20261005_1'
w=base/('fs2_screening_worker_'+suffix);sel=base/('fs2_selection_panel_'+suffix)
panel=base/('fs2_panel_'+suffix);screen=w/'fs2_screening_batch'
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text())
def artifact(p):return {'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size}
def t(c):return datetime.fromisoformat(c['utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
wrapper={k:base/('fs2_lifecycle_pilot_20261005_1_'+v) for k,v in {'launch':'launch.json','result':'result.json','stdout':'stdout.jsonl','stderr':'stderr.log'}.items()}
report=read(w/'worker_report.json');sr=read(screen/'screening_report.json');sp=read(screen/'screening_policy.json');plan=read(sel/'selection_plan.json')
runtime=report['runtime'];rpolicy=next(base.glob('fs2_runtime_'+suffix+'/runtime_policy.json'));rroot=rpolicy.parent
origins=[]
for child in sorted((rroot/'origins').iterdir()):
 intent=read(child/'origin_intent.json');facts=read(child/'origin_facts.json') if (child/'origin_facts.json').exists() else None
 ack=read(child/'origin_facts_ack.json') if facts else None
 result=next(o for o in runtime['origins'] if o['intent_id']==intent['slot']['intent_id'])
 origins.append({'intent':intent,'facts':facts,'facts_ack':ack,'result':result,'artifacts':[artifact(p) for p in child.glob('*.json')]})
observed={o['intent']['member']['market_id'] for o in origins if o['result']['state']=='observed'}
triggered={a['trigger_id']:a['market_id'] for a in sr['plan']['assignments'] if a['arm']=='triggered' and a['market_id'] in observed}
pairs=[{'control_market_id':a['market_id'],'trigger_market_id':triggered[tid],'trigger_id':tid} for a in sr['plan']['assignments'] if a['arm']=='control' and a['market_id'] in observed for tid in a['matched_trigger_ids'] if tid in triggered]
valid=[o for o in runtime['outcomes'] if o['target'] is not None and o['target']['selected'] is not None]
receipts=[read(p) for root in (w,rroot) for p in sorted(root.rglob('receipt.json')) if p.parent.parent.name.startswith('fs2_capture_')]
roots={'panel':panel,'selection':sel,'worker':w,'runtime':rroot,'activation':base/('fs2_activation_'+suffix)}
data={'decision':'D089','implementation_commit':read(wrapper['launch'])['implementation_commit'],'protocol':'docs/implementation/PHASE_03_FRESH_WINDOW_PILOT_PROTOCOL.md','protocol_commit':read(wrapper['launch'])['implementation_commit'],'source_frame':next(json.loads(line)['root'] for line in wrapper['stdout'].read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(line)['stage']=='frame_owned'),'roots':{k:str(v) for k,v in roots.items()},'wrapper_result':read(wrapper['result']),'artifacts':[artifact(p) for p in [*wrapper.values(),w/'worker_report.json',w/'worker_policy.json',screen/'screening_report.json',screen/'screening_policy.json',sel/'selection_plan.json',rpolicy,rroot/'runtime_report.json']],'retained_bytes':{k:sum(p.stat().st_size for p in r.rglob('*') if p.is_file()) for k,r in roots.items()},'requests':{'count':len(receipts),'counts_by_source_status':dict(Counter(f"{r['source_id']}:{r['status']}" for r in receipts)),'raw_bytes':sum(r['raw_bytes'] for r in receipts),'receipts':receipts},'stratum_draw':plan['stratum_draw'],'first_stage_assignments':plan['assignments'],'second_stage_plan':sr['plan'],'screening_states':sr['states'],'role_capacity':report['role_capacity'],'original_recovery':report['recovery'],'unfilled_control_slots':sum(s['unfilled_control_slots'] for s in sr['plan']['strata']),'origins':origins,'runtime':runtime,'observed_matched_pairs':pairs,'execution_gates':{'original_audit':read(wrapper['result'])['returncode']==0 and len(report['recovery'])==1,'six_of_eight_observed':len(observed)>=6,'observed_matched_pair':bool(pairs),'four_fifths_targets':bool(observed) and 5*len(valid)>=4*len(observed)},'observed_origin_count':len(observed),'valid_target_count':len(valid),'accepted_panel':False,'limitations':['Pilot execution only; not a model dataset, predictive-edge result or economic-value claim.','Source event membership and economic independence remain unresolved.','Role overlap does not increase independent sample count.','Incomplete flow, persistent book windows, related-market signals and selected external relevance remain unavailable.','No redraw, retrospective threshold change or label substitution.']}

def at(value):
 if isinstance(value,dict):value=value.get('utc',value.get('$utc'))
 return datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace('Z','+00:00'))
def us(a,b):
 d=at(a)-at(b)
 return (d.days*86400+d.seconds)*1000000+d.microseconds
origin_timing=[]
for o in origins:
 if o['facts'] is None:continue
 f=o['facts'];i=o['intent']
 origin_timing.append({'market_id':i['member']['market_id'],'origin_id':i['slot']['intent_id'],
  'scheduled_to_freeze_us':us(f['origin_at'],i['slot']['scheduled_at']),
  'freeze_to_save_us':us(o['facts_ack']['durable_ack'],f['origin_at']),
  'book_receipt_to_freeze_us':us(f['origin_at'],f['projection']['quote']['received_at'])})
target_details=[]
for child in sorted((rroot/'targets').iterdir()):
 intent=read(child/'target_intent.json')
 facts=read(child/'target_facts.json') if (child/'target_facts.json').exists() else None
 receipt=read(child/'target_receipt.json');ack=read(child/'target_receipt_ack.json')
 target_details.append({'intent':intent,'facts':facts,'receipt':receipt,'receipt_ack':ack,
  'scheduled_to_durable_receipt_us':us(ack['durable_ack'],intent['job']['scheduled_at']),
  'artifacts':[artifact(p) for p in child.glob('*.json')]})
data['origin_timing']=origin_timing
data['target_details']=target_details
data['execution_gates']['reporting_complete']=len(receipts)<=56 and all(
 o['facts'] is None or ('feature_manifest' in o['facts']['projection'] and
 o['facts']['projection']['feature_manifest']['continuous_window_eligible'] is False)
 for o in origins)
data['clocks']={'screening_cutoff':sr['cutoff'],'screening_computed':sr['computed_at'],
 'screening_available':read(screen/'screening_report_ack.json')['durable_ack'],
 'runtime_finished':runtime['finished_at'],'original_recovery_completed':report['recovery'][0]['completed_at']}

from fractions import Fraction
windows=[]
for path in sorted(w.glob('window_[0-9][0-9][0-9].json')):
 entry=read(path);index=path.stem.rsplit('_',1)[1]
 sockets=w/('fs2_socket_window_'+index);analysis=w/('fs2_socket_analysis_'+index)
 windows.append({'entry':entry,'artifacts':[artifact(path),artifact(path.with_name(path.stem+'_ack.json'))]+[artifact(p) for root in (sockets,analysis) if root.exists() for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]})
data['windows']=windows
eligible_history=[]
for o in origins:
 if o['facts'] is None:continue
 projection=o['facts']['projection'];win=projection.get('pre_origin_window')
 if win is None:continue
 h=win['history']
 if h:
  def fraction(x):return Fraction(int(x['numerator']),int(x['denominator']))
  assert fraction(h['current_midpoint'])-fraction(h['prior_midpoint'])==fraction(h['midpoint_change'])
  assert Fraction(us(h['current_received_at'],h['prior_received_at']),1000)==fraction(h['receipt_separation_ms'])
 if (o['result']['state']=='observed' and win['eligible_at_freeze']
     and win['subscription_sent_at'] is not None
     and win['socket_terminal']=='interval_ended' and win['socket_close_state']=='closed'
     and at(win['subscription_sent_at'])<at(win['window_ended_at'])<=at(win['cutoff'])<=at(win['frozen_at'])
     and win['cutoff']==o['facts']['read_started_at'] and win['frozen_at']==o['facts']['origin_at']):
  eligible_history.append(o['intent']['member']['market_id'])
data['eligible_completed_window_history_markets']=eligible_history
data['execution_gates']['six_of_eight_completed_windows_and_history']=len(set(eligible_history))>=6
data['execution_gates']['reporting_complete']=data['execution_gates']['reporting_complete'] and len(windows)==8
window_summaries=[]
for e in windows:
 v=e['entry'];a=v['analysis'];sock=v['socket'];coverage=None
 if a:
  index=Path(e['artifacts'][0]['path']).stem.rsplit('_',1)[1]
  coverage=read(w/('fs2_socket_analysis_'+index)/'socket_analysis_facts.json')['projection']['coverage']
 window_summaries.append({'market_id':v['item']['member']['market_id'],
  'question':v['item']['identity']['question'],'missing_reason':v['missing_reason'],
  'socket':sock,'coverage':coverage})
data['window_summaries']=window_summaries
data['execution_success']=all(data['execution_gates'].values())
data['source_frame_report']=next(json.loads(line)['report'] for line in wrapper['stdout'].read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(line)['stage']=='frame_complete')
all_artifacts=data['artifacts']+[a for o in origins for a in o['artifacts']]+[a for w in windows for a in w['artifacts']]
for a in all_artifacts:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(a['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['sha256'] and Path(a['path']).stat().st_size==a['bytes']
data['independent_artifact_check_count']=len(all_artifacts)
def rat(x):return Fraction(int(x['numerator']),int(x['denominator']))
assert rat(data['stratum_draw']['stratum_inclusion_probability'])==Fraction(data['stratum_draw']['selected_strata'],data['stratum_draw']['eligible_strata'])
for a in data['first_stage_assignments']:
 assert rat(a['inclusion_probability'])==rat(a['stratum_inclusion_probability'])*rat(a['conditional_market_inclusion_probability'])
Path('docs/implementation/PHASE_03_FRESH_WINDOW_PILOT_EVIDENCE.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:data[k] for k in ['execution_gates','observed_origin_count','valid_target_count','unfilled_control_slots','retained_bytes']}))
print(data['requests']['counts_by_source_status'],data['requests']['raw_bytes'])

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://hltv.org. However, if https://hltv.org has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

identity.question: Will France win the UEFA EURO 2028?
identity.rules_text:
This market will resolve according to the nation that wins the UEFA EURO 2028. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed nation to win the UEFA EURO 2028 per the rules of UEFA (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the UEFA EURO 2028 is cancelled, postponed after July 23, 2028, 11:59 PM ET or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from UEFA; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

identity.question: Spread: Saints (-2.5)
identity.rules_text:
In the upcoming NFL game, scheduled for October 5 at 8:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Saints" if the Saints win the game by 3 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Falcons". If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve to "Falcons".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

identity.question: Spread: France (-1.5)
identity.rules_text:
In the upcoming UEFA Nations League game, scheduled for October 5 at 2:45 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "France" if France win the game by 2 or more goals.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Belgium".

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50–50.

This market will resolve according to the official final score published on uefa.com. This market refers only to the outcome within the first 90 minutes of regular play plus stoppage time.

The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, data from Flashscore may be used; if Flashscore data is unavailable, data from Sofascore may be used; if neither is available, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead. All markets will settle based on the official final result as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. Revisions to officially declared final scores made after market resolution will not be accounted for in determining the outcome. If no acceptable data is available within 24 hours of the event's conclusion, this market will resolve 50-50, or to "Draw" where applicable.

screening_assignment.probability_scope: market in complete eligible frame; stratum then market draw

identity.question: LoL: Natus Vincere vs FlyQuest - Game 1 Winner
identity.rules_text:
This market refers to the LoL Round 2 match between Natus Vincere and FlyQuest in the Demacia Cup Global Invitational Group Stage, initially scheduled for October 5, 2026 at 3:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Natus Vincere" if Natus Vincere win Game 1 against FlyQuest.

This market will resolve to "FlyQuest" if FlyQuest win Game 1 against Natus Vincere.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Game 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Game 1. 

If Game 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before October 19, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 5, 2026 at 3:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

screening_assignment.probability_scope: market in complete eligible frame; stratum then market draw

identity.question: Will Matt Mahan win the California Governor Election in 2026?
identity.rules_text:
This market will resolve to according to the candidate who wins the 2026 California gubernatorial election currently scheduled for November 3, 2026.

If the results of the election are not confirmed by July 31, 2027, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race in this state for the same candidate, this market will resolve based on official certification.

screening_assignment.probability_scope: market in complete eligible frame; stratum then market draw

identity.question: Will Yair Golan be the next Prime Minister of Israel?
identity.rules_text:
Legislative elections are schedule to be held in Israel on October 27, 2026. 

This market will resolve to the next individual who is officially appointed and sworn in as Prime Minister of Israel following the 2026 parliamentary election. If an election is called early, this market will immediately resolve to the individual who is officially appointed and sworn in after that election.

To count for resolution, the individual must be formally sworn in. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister is sworn in by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Government of Israel; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

screening_assignment.probability_scope: market in complete eligible frame; stratum then market draw
